newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Striking Brazil portworkers return to work - union.
newsitem.headline: Striking Brazil portworkers return to work - union.

text.p: The Administrative Portworkers' Union at Brazil's port of Santos voted late on Monday evening to resume work immediately, putting an end to a day-long strike, a union spokesman said.
"The strike is over. Everyone has gone back to work," a spokesman for the union said.
The warehouse workers, who have been striking over a backpay dispute since 7 a.m. (1000 GMT) on Monday, decided to return to work after talks with the port authority (Codesp).
Port authority officials and union leaders are scheduled to hold talks on warehouse workers' working conditions at 09.30 am (1230 GMT) on Tuesday.
Union officials said earlier that the strike was affecting 90 percent of imports as well as a smaller percentage of exports. But port officials said exports were unaffected by the strike.
